summary: End-to-end testing of Cartoonix PLUS playlist feature. Backend: all 13 pytest cases passed (login, list/create/add-episode/already-added/legacy-add-cartoon-15-episodes/reorder-reverse/delete-episode/delete-playlist + FREE-user 403). Frontend: PLUS-user UI flow verified — cartoon detail page shows 'Adaugă în playlist' button, episode list has overflow-y-auto with 15 episodes scrollable, per-episode '+' button (data-testid=episode-add-to-playlist-*) opens episode-mode dialog, AddToPlaylistDialog supports inline create + add (success toast 'Desen adăugat în playlist'), ProfilePage playlists tab displays cards with episode count + Redă, /playlist/{id} loads PlaylistPlayerPage with video, queue sidebar ('În coadă'), Anterior/Următor/Loop controls.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2264+ lines — recommend splitting playlist endpoints into a routers/playlists.py module for maintainability.
GET /api/me/playlists silently returns [] for FREE users while create/get/add return 403. Inconsistent — consider always returning 403 OR always returning [] so frontend has one code path.

PlaylistPlayerPage video onEnded auto-advance could not be fully verified live (test playlist had only 1 episode). Backend ordering verified via reorder test. Recommend main agent runs a manual multi-episode test.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all visible flows verified; auto-advance onEnded handler exists in code but live multi-episode advance not observed because Redă button was clicked on a 1-episode playlist)
